name: java-toolchain
label: Java build tools
description: Maven and Gradle, each with a build check, a test check and the CLI itself. Both are defined; configure the one your project uses and leave the other inert, or configure both and let the caller pick.

tools.label: Maven build
tools.description: Compiles the project in batch mode and reports the compiler errors Maven prints as [ERROR] path:[line,col] message.

tools.label: Maven test
tools.description: Runs the tests and reports each failure from Surefire's [ERROR] Class.method:line message summary. Compile errors during the test phase print in the build shape instead — run the build check for those.

tools.label: mvn
tools.description: The Maven CLI itself, for a one-off goal (mvn -v, mvn dependency:tree) through run_command.

tools.label: Gradle build
tools.description: Builds the project without running tests; Gradle passes javac's file:line: error: message diagnostics through unchanged.

tools.label: Gradle test
tools.description: Runs the tests and reports each failure at the source line Gradle prints beneath it (Exception at File.java:line).

tools.label: gradle
tools.description: The Gradle CLI itself, for a one-off task (gradle -v, gradle tasks) through run_command.
